dataset_count.description: How many datasets the caller may describe hold `measure` under `metric_id`. It counts this one name: merging the two metrics moves every variant of `metric_id`.

suggested_merges.description: Likely merges: `measure` is `into_measure` plus `word`, or the same name when `axis` is `name`, from names alone. When `axis` is `calculation`, both metrics hold a base measure with the same DAX once normalised and its measure references written out, usually under two names. That says nothing of the rows in each model, so check both. One entry for the two names under the two metrics, however many datasets hold them. Both metrics' variants name the measures.

hidden_suggested_merges.description: Entries from a period or currency word left out because a measure on one side is out of the caller's reach or PII. They are counted, never named.

suggested_merges_truncated.description: True when a measure name of this draft that the caller may describe was not looked up for period or currency pairs, because the draft's names, with all the others on the page, passed the limit on what one read of likely merges builds. Pairs from that name may be missing. It is false when only names out of the caller's reach were left out.
